rewrites.//: The API runs on Render, but the browser only ever talks to THIS origin. That is deliberate: a same-origin proxy keeps the session cookie first-party, so it needs neither SameSite=None nor CORS — and browsers are actively phasing third-party cookies out. Replace the host below with your own Render service URL.

SPA fallback. Vercel checks the filesystem BEFORE rewrites, so the 46 prerendered route files still serve themselves and their own Open Graph tags; this only catches paths that match no file, and lets React Router render the storefront's own 404.
